Non-vacuity is PROVEN by two nearest-wrong overrides that must MOVE the board: generic 38.91% attackDamagePct, and permanent 9.09% damageTakenPct.

fixtures: controlComp('jackal', true) for every run — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / jackal / helm(B3), deterministic, no seed. Six hoisted 180s runs: base; skill2+burst stripped; skill1 stripped; nearest-wrong generic 38.91% attackDamagePct; nearest-wrong permanent 9.09% damageTakenPct; and a marker run adding an inert defPct 0.001 self-buff on jackal's own burstCast. CAVEAT (the fixture's real risk): jackal is Burst I and controlComp already seats liter at stage 1, so stage-1 selection may never pick jackal and her burst blocks may never fire. The marker run answers that question WITHOUT reading her committed override, and 'jackal actually casts her own burst in this fixture' is a hard gate — if it is RED, every burst-line assertion is vacuous and the fixture must be rebuilt without liter. The fixed-B3 helm slot is kept (true) because helm's buffs are irrelevant to jackal's purely defensive kit and dropping her would cost a Full Burst chain.
